issues.title: Outcome beat: slow down after a slice, spotlight the answer, pause before the next question
issues.body:
Owner feedback: after a slice everything moved on too quickly; mistakes should be obvious, the correct move should be highlighted even on success, and there should be a beat before the next question.

Shipped in 85711b9: `arena.reveal()` freezes the wave, the sliced bubble stays with a ✓ (or ✗ beside the glowing right answer), the card turns green/red and fills the answer into the gap, then a hold (1 s / 1.8 s / 1.5 s) and a gap before the next wave. Sprint stays brisk.

issues.title: Long sentences: bubbles overlapped and were too hard even for adults
issues.body: Shipped in 85711b9: waves launch in batches sized to the screen width, radius shrinks for 7+ bubbles, the next word of a sequence is always in the first batch. e2e test samples the flight and asserts no overlap.

issues.title: Trace Words is far too lenient: tracing 2 of 3 letters passes
issues.body:
Owner feedback: sensitivity is low; sometimes writing only 2 letters of a 3-letter word counts as success.

Cause: `Tracer.result()` measures coverage over the whole word mask, so 2/3 of the letters ≈ 66 % ≥ the 60 % pass threshold.

Fix: check coverage per letter (each glyph must be ≥ ~70 % covered), keep the outside-the-lines ratio, and add unit tests for `result()` with synthetic strokes (2 of 3 letters must fail).
issues.owner_action: confirm on the phone that 2 of 3 letters now fails and a full careful trace passes

issues.title: review: adding a game mode means editing ~12 ternary chains in 5 files
issues.body:
Mode behaviour is scattered as `o.mode === 'endless' ? … : sprint ? … : boss ? …` chains (play.ts:19, 172-176, 181-189; session.ts:40-51, 134, 180-185; storage.ts:11-15, 53-70; home.ts:80-83, 99-102); Memory already had to bypass play.ts.

Fix: `src/game/modes.ts` with a `ModeSpec` table (id, title, blurb, hasLives, difficulty(n), speed(n, year), points, stars, coins, medal, headline, record); Session and play.ts read `MODES[o.mode]`; per-mode bests in one `bests: Record<Mode, Record<YearId, number>>`; island buttons rendered from the table. Do before Dojo/Duel.

issues.title: review: year ids and per-year assets hard-coded in seven places (blocks Y3–Y6)
issues.body:
`'reception' | 'year1' | 'year2'` is retyped in types.ts:37/44, storage.ts:7, home.ts:12, memory.ts:21; island art is CSS by index (.i0/.i1/.i2, grid repeat(3,1fr)); e2e picks tabs by a topic-id regex; the unit guard `Number(q.answer) <= 120` and integer-only `solve()` reject Y3+ answers.

Fix: export `YearId`, derive all unions from it; move blurb/art/maxAnswer onto `YearInfo`; `THEMES: Partial<Record<YearId, Theme[]>>` with fallback; island grid from `YEARS.length`; `data-subject` on topic buttons; range guard from `year.maxAnswer`.

issues.title: review: per-bubble per-frame allocations in drawBubble (gradient + measureText loop)
issues.body:
arena.ts drawBubble creates a radial gradient and two colour strings per bubble per frame and runs a `measureText` font-fit loop; with 8–10 word bubbles that is hundreds of measureText calls per frame on a phone.

Fix: compute font size once in spawnWave and store it on the Bubble; cache the bubble body as an offscreen sprite keyed `color|round(r)` like `glowSprite`.

issues.title: review: shadowBlur in the hot path (electric bolts, stars, tracer strokes)
issues.body:
Volt is the default avatar and its bolt particles use shadowBlur=8 on every other pointer move and 8 per burst; Sol's stars use 10; the tracer paints every segment with shadowBlur=10 — the code itself notes shadowBlur is too slow on low-end devices.

Fix: replace glows with a second wide low-alpha stroke; drop the shadow in Tracer.paint; cap particles (~250).

issues.title: review: three full-screen layers repaint under the arena during play
issues.body:
`.bg-play::after` animates 13 radial gradients via background-position (not compositor-accelerated) and `.qcard` uses backdrop-filter blur over the live canvas.

Fix: no `drift` animation on `.bg-play`; opaque-ish `.qcard` background without backdrop-filter inside `.play`.

issues.title: review: update() allocates per substep and render() runs while paused
issues.body:
Up to 6 physics substeps per frame each allocate two filtered arrays (particles, trail); render repaints while paused or with nothing alive.

Fix: compact in place once after the substep loop; skip the draw when paused or empty (keep rAF).

issues.title: review: e2e runs in real game time (holds, stagger, 150 s mission test, retries: 1)
issues.body:
Outcome holds (1–1.8 s), gaps, launch stagger and flight time make a mission test need 150 s and the config keeps `retries: 1` for flakiness.

Fix: a `?fast=N` query / `__sna.setSpeed(k)` that divides HOLD, gaps, T and stagger; run e2e at 4×; drop retries to expose real flakes.

issues.title: review: physics smuggled through `as any` (_g gravity, Tracer _size)
issues.body:
`(bubble as any)._g` hides per-bubble gravity from the Bubble type and the e2e swipe helper depends on it; `Tracer._size` is never read.

Fix: add `g: number` to Bubble; delete `_size`.

issues.title: review: window.__sna is untyped (`any`) in play.ts, memory.ts and the spec
issues.body:
The e2e contract is `(window as any).__sna` / `interface Window { __sna: any }`, so renaming a hook breaks tests only at runtime.

Fix: `src/ui/hooks.ts` with `PlayHooks`/`MemoryHooks` and a global Window declaration; `import type` in the spec.

issues.title: review: screen scaffolding duplicated between play.ts and memory.ts (later/toast/cleanup/results modal, esc, SHAPES, coin labels)
issues.body:
`later`, `toast`, `cleanup`, sticker map and results-modal markup are copy-pasted; `esc` defined twice; SHAPES2D/3D and the £/p label defined 2–3 times.

Fix: `src/ui/screen.ts` (`screenScope()`, `resultsModal()`), import `esc` from dom.ts, move SHAPES/coinLabel into curriculum/util.ts.

issues.title: review: play.ts is one 225-line closure with 30 lines over 180 chars
issues.body:
Session callbacks mix mode rules, DOM, audio and arena; nested ternaries >250 chars; hoisting oddities (show(), prevLives/drawLives used before declaration). Every future Edit has to reproduce those lines verbatim (token cost).

Fix: split into hud.ts (drawLives/Timer/Hp/toast/showOutcome) and overlays.ts (stage clear/results/pause); wrap at ~120 chars; same for home.ts 18/79-83 and style.css 97/222/292.

issues.title: review: dead code (Arena.flash, Arena.time, Bubble.scale, dom.wait, totalSlices, yearById)
issues.body:
Unused after the outcome-beat change: `Arena.flash()`, `Arena.time`, `Bubble.scale` (always 1), `dom.wait`, `SaveData.totalSlices`, `yearById`. `sensei.webp` is now used by the Master Ninja issue — keep it.

Fix: delete them.

issues.title: review: save format has a version field but no migration
issues.body:
`v: 1` / `sna:v1` are never read; load() shallow-merges DEFAULT with whatever was stored, so shape changes (bests record, Y3+) silently keep stale keys.

Fix: `migrate(raw)` switching on `raw.v`, called in load(); unit test with a v1 fixture.

issues.title: review: Tracer leaks canvas listeners per question
issues.body:
destroy() removes only the window listeners; pointerdown/pointermove on the shared #trace canvas are never removed and a new Tracer is built per question (~30 handler pairs per tracing mission).

Fix: remove canvas listeners in destroy(), or one Tracer with setText().

issues.title: review: speech cancel()+speak() on every call, per letter
issues.body:
say() always cancels then speaks synchronously (drops/stutters on iOS/Android) and onProgress speaks every sliced letter.

Fix: cancel only when speaking/pending, defer speak by a tick after cancel, skip per-letter speech (SFX confirms the step) or coalesce on completion.

issues.title: review: noise() builds a fresh random AudioBuffer per SFX
issues.body:
Each swish/slice allocates and fills a new buffer mid-frame.

Fix: one lazily built 0.5 s noise buffer, play sub-ranges with start(when, offset, duration).

issues.title: review: biased comparator shuffles despite a Fisher–Yates helper
issues.body:
session.ts:83 and arena.ts:80 use `.sort(() => rng() - 0.5)`; curriculum/util.ts exports `shuffle(rng, arr)`.

Fix: use `shuffle`.

issues.title: review: arena, visuals and tracing have zero unit tests
issues.body:
segCircle, spawnWave batch layout, reveal()'s ghost rule, renderVisual string builders and Tracer.result() thresholds are covered only by slow e2e.

Fix: extract `layoutWave()` and `segCircle` as pure exports and unit-test them; string-assert renderVisual per Visual.type; unit-test Tracer.result() with synthetic strokes (ties in with the Trace Words bug).

issues.title: review: canvas font depends on Google Fonts with no readiness gate
issues.body:
Bubble labels use Fredoka from fonts.googleapis.com with no `document.fonts` wait, so the first wave renders in the fallback font and pops mid-flight; the single-file build still needs network for the font.

Fix: `await document.fonts.load('800 24px Fredoka')` before the first spawnWave; inline the woff2 in bundle-single.mjs for the artifact build.

issues.title: review: `mode` naming collision (Session.Mode vs Topic.mode) and `.storm` class for every mode button
issues.body: Fix: rename `Topic.mode` → `Topic.input: 'bubbles' | 'tracing'`; `.storm` → `.mode-btn` with modifiers driven by the ModeSpec table.
